name: exact cover by choosing the column with fewest options
mechanism: to cover every column exactly once, pick the column with the fewest candidate rows, try each such row, remove the rows and columns it conflicts with, recurse, and undo the removals when returning

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Algorithm X' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: a nondeterministic algorithm
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Dancing Links': an efficient implementation of Algorithm X

requires: constant-time removal and restoration (the doubly linked implementation)
fails_when: exponential; the fewest-options heuristic is what keeps it usable
